name: Relative Fluency and Liking
fact: Liking ratings for fluent stimuli are affected by relative ease-of-processing only when that variation is manipulated WITHIN participants (comparing stimuli side by side), not when manipulated between different groups of participants.
boundary: Felt fluency and certainty are affected by visual clarity regardless of whether the manipulation is within- or between-participants.

provenance.title: Everything’s Relative? Relative Differences in Processing Fluency and the Effects on Liking
provenance.quote_or_locus: liking ratings were only affected when ease-of-processing was manipulated within-participants

provenance.title: Everything’s Relative? Relative Differences in Processing Fluency and the Effects on Liking
